verdict.rationale: The GST portal has a developer API portal and human-oriented help modules and manuals, so asking about llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows an llms.txt file, markdown docs for agents, or any documentation aimed at agents. The probe concerns the separate income-tax portal, and readable HTML pages are not agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
